sermon.title: Jesus Speaks to the Religious Jews Who Then Mistreat and Kill Him — April 25, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer follows Jesus’ words to the religious leaders after the Bethesda healing. They searched the Scriptures but would not come to Him for life. Whoever hears and believes passes from death to life and receives a new nature. He shares his own conversion in 1964 and teaches the first resurrection and reigning in life.
